plan.notes: Official UW-Madison Guide 2026-2027 Psychology BS. The catalog publishes major requirements with no official semester sequence, so this is recorded as requirements_only covering the published major requirements (minimum 30 credits in PSYCH coursework; recorded at 36 per minimum-credit convention). The full degree requires at least 120 credits including the L&S BS degree requirements (Communication A/B, Quantitative Reasoning A/B, Ethnic Studies, third unit of language, 2 intermediate/advanced MATH/COMP SCI/STAT courses, 12 Humanities, 12 Social Science, 12 Natural Science incl. 6 Biological + 6 Physical, 108 LAS credits, 60 intermediate/advanced credits); several major courses (e.g. PSYCH 202, statistics, biology) also satisfy breadth. Choice slots recorded at minimum per convention: statistics PSYCH 210 (3) over STAT 324/340 (4)/371 (3); biology BIOLOGY/ZOOLOGY 101 (3) over 151 (5)/BIOCORE (6); breadth courses at 3. Foundation courses require grades of C or better.
